# Increasing effective giving (& action): The puzzle, what we (need to) know

> A research synthesis on why people don't give more, or more effectively, to high-impact charities, and what the evidence says might change that.

By David Reinstein (https://www.davidreinstein.org/). More projects: https://projects.davidreinstein.org/
